subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column.
stimulus: Ambition needs a particular ambition. Almost all of us means to be competitive too. One’s ambition may be materialized and sometimes hindered. One will never be successful in life if one sits idly. cherish desire to achieve something.
guide_solution: Make sentences using table: (a) Ambition means desire to achieve something. (b) Almost all of us cherish a particular ambition. (c) One’s ambition needs to be competitive too. (d) One’s ambition may be materialized and sometimes hindered. (e) One will never be successful in life if one sits idly.
